_about: A model of five new shortcuts and one clean-up task for the Marketing team. For each shortcut set name, location (Tables, a folder under Files, or Shortcuts in a KQL database), type, target and auth. auth is caller identity or connection. cache_days is the OneLake cache retention for the shortcut's files, or null for no cache. readers_need is what someone reading through the shortcut needs on the target, or null. Then choose the clean-up action.
cleanup_actions: delete the files in the shortcut, then the shortcut

web_events.needs: In MarketingLH, read the Delta table events from Web_LH in the Web Analytics workspace as a table, without copying it. Readers query it from MarketingLH.
web_events.name: web_events

ledger.needs: In MarketingLH, read a Delta table that finance keeps in ADLS Gen2 (container finance, folder gl/ledger) as a table. Finance calls it GL ledger FY25+26.
ledger.name: gl_ledger_fy25_26

ad_spend.needs: In MarketingLH, browse the CSV and JSON exports in the Amazon S3 bucket ad-exports, which has subfolders by day. Notebooks read the same files many times a day, and egress costs matter. Keep files cached for one week after they were last read.
ad_spend.name: ad_spend

surveys.needs: In MarketingLH, browse the survey CSV files in the Google Cloud Storage bucket surveys.
surveys.name: surveys

kql_web_events.needs: In the Telemetry KQL database, query Web_LH's events table alongside the click stream, without ingesting it.
kql_web_events.name: web_events

cleanup.needs: The old shortcut old_spend in MarketingLH points at last year's folder in the S3 bucket. Remove it from MarketingLH. The files in S3 must stay where they are.
